samples.xml_description:
Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. The module accepts a dividend and a divisor as inputs and provides a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder. The design supports both signed and unsigned division operations. Clock signal used for synchronous operation. The reset signal to initialize or reset the module. 1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0). 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division. 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division. 1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present. 1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged. 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready. res_valid must be constructed as combinational logic and not in any always block. So res_valid must not be declared as register. 16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits. ADD SUB divisor_extend: 9-bit combinational logic. divisor_extend is set to concatenation of bit 1 and input divisor if the input sign and MSB of divisor is high. Otherwise, divisor_extend is set to concatenation of bit 0 and input divisor. NEG_DIVISOR: 9-bit sequencial logic. all_sub_result 10-bit combinational logic. sub_result: 9-bit combinational logic. sub_result is the first 9-bit of all_sub_result. sub_remainer_reg_divisor: combinational logic operation. 10-bit all_sub_result is set to summation of REMAINER and NEG_DIVISOR. REMAINER: 8-bit combinational logic. This is a subsection of 8-bit MSB of SR. QUOTIENT: 8-bit combinational logic. This is a subsection of 8-bit LSB of SR. CO: 1-bit combinational logic. CO is set to the MSB of all_sub_result. mux_result: 9-bit combinational logic. If CO is high, mux_result is set to sub_result else set to REMAINER. quotient_shift: 7-bit combinational logic. quotient_shift is set to 7 [7:1] bits of SR. SR_final_update: sequencial logic operation. First, the 8-bit MSB of SR is set to 8-bit mux_result. Then bit [0:0] of SR is set to CO. SR_shifting: sequencial logic operation. Concatenate SR from of first 7-bit of mux_result, 7-bit quotient_shift, 1-bit CO, and 1-bit zero. dividend_abs: 8-bit combinational logic. If sign and the MSB of input dividend is high, dividend_abs is set to two's complement of the input dividend. Otherwise, dividend_abs is set to the original input dividend only. final_remainer: 8-bit combinational logic. final_remainer is set to two's complement of REMAINER if the sign bit and MSB of register dividend is high. Otherwise, final_remainer is set to REMAINER. final_quotient: 8-bit combinational logic. final_quotient is set to two's complement of QUOTIENT if sign and MSB of register dividend is high. Otherwise, final_quotient is set to QUOTIENT. is_final_quotient_sign: 1-bit combinational logic. is_final_quotient_sign is result of the and logic of sign and the xor logic of MSB of dividend register and MSB of divisor register. Operation Start:
When opn_valid is high, res_valid is low, and start_cnt is low, the module saves the inputs dividend and divisor in to 2 8-bit corresponding regisers.
Initializes the 16-bit shift register SR with the absolute value of the original input dividend (dividend_abs) shifted left by one bit.
9-bit NEG_DIVISOR is set to divisor_extend, if the sign bit and MSB of divisor is high. Otherwise, sets 9-bit NEG_DIVISOR to two's complement of the divisor_extend.
Sets the 4-bit counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1 to begin the division process.
Division Process(If start_cnt is high, the module performs the following steps):
If most significant bit of cnt is set (the counter cnt reaches 8), the division is complete:
cnt and start_cnt are cleared. Then, based on SR_final_update method, Updates the shift register SR with the final remainder and quotient.
Otherwise, the counter cnt is incremented, and the shift register SR is updated based on the subtraction result mux_result:
Based on sub_remainer_reg_divisor, compute the summation of NEG_DIVISOR and REMAINER.
Based on SR_shifting, updates SR.
Result Validity:
res_valid is managed based on the reset signal, the counter, and whether the result has been consumed, which is signaled by the input (res_ready).
res_valid should be update directly, without passing middle register value.
res_valid is set to zero if rst is high.
Otherwise, if cnt reaches 8, res_ready is set to 1.
Otherwise, if res_valid and res_ready is all high, res_valid is set to 0. Otherwise, res_valid is set to res_valid.
Result operation:
The output result is constructed as combinational logic and is set to concatenation of final_remainer and final_quotient. Notice that, because of combinational operation, the result must not be calculated in any always block. Implement the logic for calculating the remainder and quotient using a radix-2 division algorithm. Initialize the shift register SR with the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit. Set the NEG_DIVISOR to the two's complement of the divisor if the operation is signed and the MSB of the divisor is high. Start the division process by setting the counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1. On each clock cycle, if the counter cnt is less than 8, increment the counter and update the shift register SR based on the subtraction result. Update the remainder and quotient based on the final state of the shift register SR.
